behavior: AC1 - a dispatch call writes a name -> subagent_type entry to the session's map in the state dir, and adds nothing to the decision journal
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/cmd/ ./internal/harness/ -count=1 -v -run 'TestTheDispatchMapNeverStoresAnythingButTwoIdentifiers|TestRecordDispatchRoundTrips' 2>&1 | grep -c '^--- PASS: Test' | grep -qx 2

behavior: AC2 - a call with agent_type set to a dispatched NAME resolves to the same persona as the unnamed dispatch of that persona; without the preceding dispatch it still records role-unresolved
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/cmd/ -count=1 -v -run 'TestANamedDispatchIsGatedLikeAnUnnamedOne|TestWithoutTheDispatchTheChildStillFailsOpen' 2>&1 | grep -c '^--- PASS: Test' | grep -qx 2

behavior: AC3 - an agent_type naming a persona directly still resolves without consulting the map
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/cmd/ -count=1 -v -run 'TestLoadGatePersonaSaysSoWhenARoleDoesNotResolve' 2>&1 | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestLoadGatePersonaSaysSoWhenARoleDoesNotResolve/a_role_that_resolves_is_silent'

behavior: AC4 - a witnessed built-in agent records no-role with no ENFORCEMENT IS OFF line, keeping the raw name in role_requested, by both the named and unnamed route
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/cmd/ -count=1 -v -run 'TestAWitnessedBuiltInAgentIsQuietNotAFault' 2>&1 | grep -c -- '--- PASS: TestAWitnessedBuiltInAgentIsQuietNotAFault/' | grep -qx 2

behavior: AC5 - dispatch identifiers are validated against the tool's own name pattern, no other tool_input key is read or persisted, and a rejected value never blocks
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/cmd/ ./internal/harness/ -count=1 -v -run 'TestAnUnusableDispatchNameIsNotWritten|TestValidDispatchNameMatchesTheToolsOwnConstraint|TestOnlyTheDispatchPrimitiveIsReadForDispatchArguments|TestRecordDispatchRefusesWhatItCannotSafelyStore' 2>&1 | grep -c '^--- PASS: Test' | grep -qx 4

behavior: AC6 - on a live named dispatch the journal records role_resolved where #1434's table recorded role-unresolved. Owner-gated: needs a real subagent dispatch, so it is verified by the recorded evidence in verification.md rather than by a command CI can run
AC7 - every interactive hook the manifest emits carries a timeout, asserted on what MergeHooks actually writes rather than on the manifest text
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/harness/ -count=1 -v -run 'TestEveryInteractiveHookIsBounded' 2>&1 | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestEveryInteractiveHookIsBounded'

behavior: AC8 - a dispatch named after another persona resolves to its DECLARED type, an operator's --role outranks the map, and an unwitnessed agent_type naming a persona still resolves to it
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/cmd/ -count=1 -v -run 'TestADispatchNamedAfterAnotherPersonaResolvesToItsTrueType|TestAnOperatorsRoleFlagOutranksTheDispatchMap' 2>&1 | grep -c '^--- PASS: Test' | grep -qx 2

behavior: AC9 - a witnessed dispatch whose persona record exists but will not load stays loud as role-unresolved, distinct from a built-in agent with no record directory
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/cmd/ -count=1 -v -run 'TestABrokenPersonaRecordStaysLoud' 2>&1 | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestABrokenPersonaRecordStaysLoud'
